description: This file is a Python script that demonstrates how to use the ImageAI library for custom object detection with a YOLOv3 model. It initializes a detector, sets model parameters, loads the model, performs object detection on an input image, and prints the detected objects with their probabilities and bounding box points.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Configures the detector to use the YOLOv3 model type.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the pre-trained model weights.

methods.name: setJsonPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the JSON configuration file for detection.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the model into memory based on the specified paths and settings.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromImage
methods.description: Performs object detection on the specified input image and outputs an image with detections.
